$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} &= \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(24 x - 60 \cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &= (60 \sin{\left(x \right)})+(24) \\ &= 60 \sin{\left(x \right)} + 24.\end{aligned}

y^{\prime}(\frac{\pi}{6})=24+60\sin(\frac{\pi}{6})=24+60\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=54.
